summary: BME280 humidity, pressure and temperature sensor (bme280): 7 pins, interfaces i2c; source class A.

module.title: BME280 humidity, pressure and temperature sensor

pins.name: CSB
pins.note: tie to VDDIO for I²C (datasheet p. 33)

evidence: Connecting SDO to GND results in slave address
1110110 (0x76); connection it to VDDIO results in slave address 1110111 (0x77)

interfaces.note: CSB must be connected to VDDIO to select I²C (p. 33)

abs_max.evidence: Voltage at any supply pin VDD and VDDIO pin -0.3 4.25 V
Voltage at any supply pin VDD and VDDIO pin -0.3 4.25 V

vih.evidence: Input high level Vih_si VDDIO=1.2 V to 3.6 V 80   %VDDI

vil.evidence: Input low level Vil_si VDDIO=1.2 V to 3. 6V   20 %VDDI

v_in_max.evidence: Voltage at any interface pin  -0.3 VDDIO + 0.3 V

requires.evidence: The recommended value for C1, C2 is 100 nF
SDI is bi-directional with open drain to GND
requires.note: value from the I²C pull-up calculator (bus load ≤ 400 pF, p. 35)

notes.text: Breakout boards (e.g. GY-BME280) often add a 3.3 V regulator, level shifting and pull-ups; Bosch documents the bare chip only.
Boards sold as BME280 sometimes carry a BMP280 (no humidity).
chip_id register 0xD0 reads 0x60 on a BME280 (a BMP280 reads 0x58).
notes.evidence: The “id” register contains the chip identification number chip_id[7:0], which is 0x60

notes.text: SDO must not float: an open SDO leaves the I²C address undefined.
notes.evidence: The SDO pin cannot be left floating; if left floating, the I²C address will be
